metadata.title: Google's TPU challenges Nvidia, opening a path for MediaTek to dominate ASIC supply

content.text:
Google's tensor processing unit (TPU) has emerged as Nvidia's strongest rival in the cloud AI chip market, with annual product upgrades and growing orders placing Google consistently among semiconductor suppliers' top three customers, according to industry...
